items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: Oh yeah, I played with Tony quite a while. On a boat at the Capitol during the war. Tony had a fine band on that boat.

ctx.x: No, no. I was on some bone now. And Dan, when the orchestra broke up, Dan went to school. He went to Loyola and became a teacher. Became a teacher? Yeah. He played too, he played too. What did he teach? Do you remember? He taught in St. Bernard Parish. He taught at school and the system there. Music? Yeah, he taught music. And I could never stand Lou Wap, why he didn't give him a job, with all of these funny yokels they had, you know, around there that he put on. And of course, Lou Wap, I don't want to say that.…
You played with Tony Amarico in that band. You played with him some other times too, didn't you?
Oh yeah, I played with Tony quite a while. On a boat at the Capitol during the war. Tony had a fine band on that boat.
